tools.title: Flashcards
tools.description: Queue flashcards from the conversation's sources, every card backed by a quote from its source.

workflow.promptIntro: Make flashcards for spaced-repetition review from this conversation's sources. generate_flashcards queues the deck; the cards are written in the background from the source text, each backed by a quote.
additionalPromptLines: The flashcards cover the sources the user @mentioned, otherwise the sources selected for this conversation; folders count as the documents in them. generate_flashcards reads them itself: pass no source names, paths or ids.

Call generate_flashcards without asking first. Pass only what the user asked for: a size (fewer, standard or more) or an exact number of cards, a difficulty (easy, mixed or hard), a focus in the user's own words, and an output language if they named one. Leave everything else out.
If generate_flashcards reports that there are no sources, do not call it again: ask the user to select or @mention the sources to make flashcards from, then run /flashcards again.

If generate_flashcards reports too many sources, do not call it again: tell the user the limit it gives and ask them to narrow the selection or @mention the sources to make flashcards from, then run /flashcards again.
After generate_flashcards returns, follow its nextStep: the flashcards are being generated and will appear in the Hub's Artifacts tab, or they are already there. Do not write any cards yourself.
